defects.description: Description: "Reach ONE arm up and bend it so the hand rests near the head or hair, and let the OTHER arm relax naturally along the floor." Currently leftShoulder=-110 AND rightShoulder=-110 (BOTH arms overhead). OTHER arm should be at side relaxed along floor.

hipAbductL=-20 (L outward LEFT) + hipAbductR=-18 (R outward RIGHT) → both legs fall APART. Description says "Bend both knees and let them drape gently to ONE SIDE". The knees_to_one_side flag was real defect (not false positive) — current state is APART, not tilted-to-one-side.
L arm overhead (abd 110°) + elbow 95° (moderate bend) leaves wristL 0.649m from head. Description says hand "rests near the head or hair" — needs deeper elbow bend to bring hand closer.

regression_risk: low — R arm changes from overhead to side; L elbow deepens; hipAbduct sign flip on R. Re-render verify recommended.
rationale: L arm (overhead, hand near hair): PRESERVED leftShoulder=-110, shoulderFwdL=10. leftElbow 95 → 130 (deeper bend brings wristL closer to head, distance 0.649 → 0.512). R arm (relaxed along floor): rightShoulder -110 → 0 (arm hangs down at side), rightElbow 20 → 0 (straight), shoulderFwdR 5 → 0 (no swing). With globalTilt=-85 (mostly supine), arm hangs down in body frame → extends sideways along floor in world (wristR at y=0.070, near floor). hipAbductR -18 → +15 (R leg crosses LEFT per corrected convention + = adduction/inward; combined with hipAbductL=-20, both knees tilt LEFT to one side). Ankle distance 0.776 → 0.294 (knees now tilted, not apart). globalTilt=-85 verified SUPINE (per cron-round-1 fix).
